name: Puria method
summary: The Puria method EA is a trend-following expert advisor based on moving average crossover signals combined with MACD confirmation. It enters long positions when faster MAs cross above slower MAs and MACD confirms momentum, and enters short positions on the opposite conditions. The EA manages positions with fixed stop loss and take profit levels while applying the Puria trading methodology.
summary_zh: Puria方法EA是一个基于移动平均线交叉信号并结合MACD确认的趋势跟踪专家顾问。当较快均线向上穿越较慢均线且MACD确认动量时做多，反之做空。该EA使用固定止损和止盈水平管理仓位，应用Puria交易方法论。
strategy_analysis: Puria方法策略的核心概念是基于多周期移动平均线的交叉来判断趋势方向，并结合MACD指标作为动量确认过滤假信号。入场条件为：快速移动平均线穿越慢速移动平均线，同时MACD指标的柱状图或信号线方向与交叉方向一致时开仓。出场条件包括固定止损和止盈，当价格触及预设的止损或止盈水平时平仓。仓位管理采用固定手数方式，未根据账户余额或波动率进行动态调整。资金管理方面缺乏风险比例控制，没有根据账户权益自动计算仓位大小的机制。整体策略逻辑清晰，但依赖参数优化的程度较高，不同品种和周期可能需要不同的参数设置。
strategy_analysis_en: The Puria method strategy concept is centered on moving average crossovers across multiple timeframes to identify trend direction, with MACD serving as a momentum confirmation filter to reduce false signals. Entry conditions require the faster moving average to cross the slower moving average while the MACD histogram or signal line aligns with the crossover direction, triggering a trade in the trend direction. Exit conditions rely on fixed stop loss and take profit levels, closing positions when price reaches the predefined thresholds. Position sizing uses a fixed lot approach without dynamic adjustment based on account balance, equity, or market volatility. Money management lacks proportional risk control, as there is no mechanism to automatically calculate position size based on account equity or risk percentage. The overall strategy logic is clear and straightforward, but it is highly dependent on parameter optimization, with different instruments and timeframes likely requiring distinct parameter configurations.
pros: 策略逻辑清晰，使用均线交叉加MACD双重确认，减少假信号
固定止损止盈设置明确，每笔交易风险可控
趋势跟踪策略在明确趋势行情中表现良好，能捕捉较大波段
代码结构简洁，参数可调节性强，便于优化和适配不同品种
pros_en: Clear strategy logic using MA crossover with MACD dual confirmation reduces false signals
Fixed stop loss and take profit provide defined risk per trade
Trend-following approach performs well in trending markets, capturing significant moves
Clean code structure with adjustable parameters allows optimization across different instruments
cons: 固定手数缺乏动态仓位管理，无法根据账户规模和风险自动调整
均线交叉策略在震荡市中容易产生频繁虚假信号导致连续亏损
缺乏移动止损或追踪止损机制，可能无法锁定浮动盈利
MACD作为滞后指标可能导致入场延迟，错过趋势初期部分利润
未考虑点差和滑点过滤，在短线交易中成本影响较大
cons_en: Fixed lot sizing lacks dynamic position management, unable to auto-adjust based on account size and risk
MA crossover strategies generate frequent false signals in ranging markets leading to consecutive losses
No trailing stop mechanism to lock in floating profits as the trend progresses
MACD as a lagging indicator may cause delayed entries, missing early trend profits
No spread or slippage filter, making transaction costs significant for shorter timeframe trading
improvements: 增加动态仓位管理，根据账户权益和风险比例自动计算交易手数
添加移动止损功能，在趋势发展中逐步锁定利润
增加ATR指标用于动态止损止盈，适应不同市场波动环境
添加震荡市过滤器（如ADX或布林带宽度），在横盘时减少交易频率
improvements_en: Add dynamic position sizing based on account equity and risk percentage for better money management
Implement trailing stop functionality to progressively lock in profits as trends develop
Incorporate ATR indicator for dynamic stop loss and take profit levels to adapt to varying market volatility
Add a ranging market filter (such as ADX or Bollinger Band width) to reduce trade frequency during sideways markets

risk_points: 固定手数未根据账户规模动态调整，大额交易可能造成过大风险敞口
缺乏新K线检查机制，可能在同一K线内重复开仓
未包含点差过滤，高点差环境下止损可能过近导致不必要的止损触发
震荡市中均线交叉频繁产生虚假信号，可能造成连续亏损
risk_points_en: Fixed lot size does not dynamically adjust with account size, potentially creating excessive risk exposure
Lack of new bar check may cause repeated position opening within the same candle
No spread filter means high-spread environments may trigger stop losses too close to entry
Ranging markets cause frequent false crossover signals, potentially leading to consecutive losses

The EA manages positions with fixed stop loss and take profit levels while applying the Puria trading methodology.
